author: Rear Admiral Samuel J. Cox, USN (Ret.), Naval History and Heritage Command (NHHC)
locator: H-Gram 018, Attachment 1; sections on 1984–87 Tanker War (451 ship attacks), Operation Earnest Will, Bridgeton mining (24 July 1987), USS Samuel B. Roberts mining (14 April 1988), Operation Praying Mantis (18 April 1988), and Iran Air Flight 655 (3 July 1988)
notes: Primary naval command history documenting both the preservation of Gulf oil transit under reflagged convoys and the acute escalation hazards: initial lack of U.S. mine-countermeasure (MCM) ships when Bridgeton struck a mine, the surface battle of Operation Praying Mantis (paired with Presidential orders halting the Rakhsh strike and sparing Sabalan), and the USS Vincennes shootdown of Iran Air Flight 655 (290 killed).
rights: U.S. Department of the Navy official historical record; public domain.
title: H-018-1: No Higher Honor—The Road to Operation Praying Mantis, 18 April 1988 (The Tanker War)
